summary: The V1.0 implementation and automated release-candidate pipeline are complete. Stable V1.0 remains blocked by independent security review, qualified professional method review, live provider evidence, clean-install validation, and applicable platform signing.

gates.note: Repository-wide maintainer audit and reproducible local quality commands; this is not an independent review.
Windows, macOS, and Linux jobs are defined; successful hosted-run evidence must be linked for a promoted release.
Draft release automation generates checksums, an SPDX JSON SBOM, and GitHub build provenance.
Named public-authority sources were checked on 2026-08-12; this is not professional crisis-service review.
No independent security report has been completed.
All seven official method manifests accurately remain unreviewed.
Protocol fixtures pass, but no complete bounded live-provider matrix has been accepted.
The guides and automation exist, but clean-device validation on every supported platform is pending.
No Apple signing/notarization identity or signed artifact evidence is configured.
No Windows Authenticode identity or signed artifact evidence is configured.
